newsitem.title: USA: CME live cattle futures speed higher near close.
newsitem.headline: CME live cattle futures speed higher near close.

text.p: CME live cattle futures sped higher in fast market conditions immediately ahead of the close on buying triggered by higher beef prices Friday and forecasts for higher cash cattle prices next week, traders said.
Cattle futures traded lower most of the session, but turned higher in the closing minutes on a mix of commercial and commission house buying, traders said.
Gains accelerated when chart-based buy orders were activated above 65.00 cents per lb in the August.
Higher beef prices Friday boosted optimism that packers may raise next week's bids for cattle.
USDA beef cutout values at 1130 CDT Friday were up $0.08 to $0.59 per cwt from Thursday's close.
Plains feedlot sources priced next week's cattle from $63.00 to $65.00 per cwt, versus this week's sales from $61.00 to $62.00.
CME live cattle closed up 0.775 to 0.025 cent with August up the most at 65.750.
